questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
अभिकथन (A) : सभी विनिर्माण उद्योग कच्चे माल के साथ जुड़े हुए हैं।
कारण (R) : संसाधन मनुष्य के जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक हैं।
विकल्प :
(A) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
(B) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
(C) (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) गलत है।
(D) (A) गलत है, लेकिन (R) सही है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): All manufacturing industries are associated with raw materials.
Reason (R): Resources are essential for human survival.
Options:
(A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(B) Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(C) (A) is correct, but (R) is incorrect.
(D) (A) is incorrect, but (R) is correct.

options.A: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Both statements are factually true in their own right. Manufacturing industries do require raw materials, and resources are indeed essential for survival. However, the reason provided does not explain why manufacturing industries are linked to raw materials, making option B the correct choice.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन से खनन से सम्बन्धित कथन सही हैं? सही विकल्प चुनिए ।
i. प्राचीनकाल में खनिजों का उपयोग औज़ार तथा हथियार बनाने के लिए किया जाता था ।
ii. सभी विकसित देश अपने विकास के लिए अधिक खनिजों को निकालते हैं।
iii. खनन का वास्तविक विकास औद्योगिक क्रांति के पश्चात हुआ ।
iv. खनिजों की खोज की कई अवस्थाएँ हैं।
विकल्प :
(A) केवल ii, iii और iv सही हैं।
(B) केवल i, ii और iv सही हैं।
(C) केवल i, iii और iv सही हैं।
(D) केवल i, ii और iii सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following statements are correct related to mining? Choose the correct option:
i. In ancient times minerals were used to make tools and weapons.
ii. All developed countries are extracting more minerals for their development.
iii. The actual development of mining began with the industrial revolution.
iv. There are many stages in the discovery of minerals.
Options:
(A) Only ii, iii and iv are correct.
(B) Only i, ii and iv are correct.
(C) Only i, iii and iv are correct.
(D) Only i, ii and iii are correct.

options.A: केवल ii, iii और iv सही हैं।
options.B: केवल i, ii और iv सही हैं।
options.C: केवल i, iii और iv सही हैं।
options.D: केवल i, ii और iii सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only ii, iii and iv are correct.
options_english.B: Only i, ii and iv are correct.
options_english.C: Only i, iii and iv are correct.
options_english.D: Only i, ii and iii are correct.

questions.solution: Statements i, iii, and iv are historically and factually accurate regarding the development and discovery stages of mining. Statement ii is incorrect because developed countries often import minerals rather than necessarily extracting more domestically. Thus, C is the correct answer.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से चतुर्थक क्रियाकलाप की प्रमुख विशेषता की पहचान कीजिए :
(A) विकास के लिए यह खनिजों को निकालने से संबंधित है ।
(B) यह कच्चे माल को तैयार उत्पाद में बदलकर उसके मूल्य में वृद्धि करने से संबंधित है।
(C) यह अनुसंधान एवं विकास से संबंधित है।
(D) यह समाज के सभी लोगों की सेवा से संबंधित है ।
questions.text_english:
Identify the main characteristics of quaternary activity from the following:
(A) It is associated with extraction of minerals for development.
(B) It is confined to increase the value of raw materials into finished products.
(C) It is concerned with research and development.
(D) It is linked with serving all the people of society.

options.A: विकास के लिए यह खनिजों को निकालने से संबंधित है ।
options.B: यह कच्चे माल को तैयार उत्पाद में बदलकर उसके मूल्य में वृद्धि करने से संबंधित है।
options.C: यह अनुसंधान एवं विकास से संबंधित है।
options.D: यह समाज के सभी लोगों की सेवा से संबंधित है ।

options_english.A: It is associated with extraction of minerals for development.
options_english.B: It is confined to increase the value of raw materials into finished products.
options_english.C: It is concerned with research and development.
options_english.D: It is linked with serving all the people of society.

questions.solution: Quaternary activities are knowledge-oriented, involving specialized services like research, development, and information technology. Option C accurately reflects this. A refers to primary, B to secondary, and D is too broad to define quaternary.

questions.text:
एशिया के निम्नलिखित वायुपत्तनों को उनकी अवस्थितियों के आधार पर पश्चिम से पूर्व व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
i. बीजिंग
ii. टोक्यो
iii. अदन
iv. मुंबई
विकल्प :
(A) iv, iii, ii और i
(B) iv, iii, i और ii
(C) iii, iv, ii और i
(D) iii, iv, i और ii
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following airports of Asia from west to east as per their locations and choose the correct option:
i. Beijing
ii. Tokyo
iii. Aden
iv. Mumbai
Options:
(A) iv, iii, ii and i
(B) iv, iii, i and ii
(C) iii, iv, ii and i
(D) iii, iv, i and ii
questions.solution: The correct west-to-east sequence is Aden (Yemen), Mumbai (India), Beijing (China), and Tokyo (Japan). This corresponds to iii, iv, i, ii.

questions.text:
एक पत्तन के द्वारा निर्यात की जाने वाली वस्तुएँ पहले विभिन्न देशों से लाई जाती हैं। इस प्रकार के पत्तन को _______ के रूप में जाना जाता है।
(A) विस्तृत पत्तन
(B) बाह्य (आउट) पत्तन
(C) आंत्रपो पत्तन
(D) पैकेट स्टेशन
questions.text_english:
The exported items by a port is first brought from different countries. This port is known as _______
(A) Comprehensive Port
(B) Outports
(C) Entrepot Ports
(D) Packet Station
questions.solution: An entrepot port is a trading port where merchandise is imported, stored, or traded, and then re-exported. This fits the definition given in the question.

questions.text:
भारत के तेलशोधन कारखानों को दक्षिण से उत्तर दिशा में उनकी अवस्थितियों के आधार पर व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
i. मुंबई
ii. कोच्चि
iii. कयाली
iv. मंगलूरु
विकल्प :
(A) ii, iv, iii और i
(B) ii, iv, i और iii
(C) iv, ii, i और iii
(D) iv, ii, iii और i
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following oil refineries of India from south to north direction as per their locations and choose the correct option:
i. Mumbai
ii. Kochchi
iii. Kayali
iv. Mangaluru
Options:
(A) ii, iv, iii and i
(B) ii, iv, i and iii
(C) iv, ii, i and iii
(D) iv, ii, iii and i
questions.solution: Ordering from southernmost to northernmost: Kochchi (Kerala), Mangaluru (Karnataka), Mumbai (Maharashtra), and Kayali/Koyali (Gujarat). Thus, the sequence is ii, iv, i, iii.

questions.text:
राजस्थान नहर के प्रथम चरण के निर्माण के जिले की पहचान कीजिए ।
(A) जैसलमेर
(B) बाड़मेर
(C) जोधपुर
(D) गंगानगर
questions.text_english:
Identify the district of first phase of construction of Rajasthan canal.
(A) Jaisalmer
(B) Barmer
(C) Jodhpur
(D) Ganganagar
questions.solution: The first phase of the Rajasthan Canal (Indira Gandhi Canal) project was primarily focused on providing irrigation to the Ganganagar district, as it was the initial area serviced.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से गैस अथॉरिटी ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड (गेल) के मुख्य उद्देश्य की पहचान कीजिए ।
(A) अपने डिपो में प्राकृतिक गैस का परिवहन एवं संचय करना ।
(B) गैस का प्रसंस्करण और विभिन्न राज्यों को आवंटन करना ।
(C) प्राकृतिक गैस का परिवहन, प्रसंस्करण और विपणन करना ।
(D) अधिक लाभ के लिए भंडारित प्राकृतिक गैस की बिक्री करना ।
questions.text_english:
Identify the main objective of Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL) from the following:
(A) To transport and store natural gas at its depot.
(B) To process and allocate natural gas to different states.
(C) To transport, process and market natural gas.
(D) To sale, stored natural gas for greater profit.

options.A: अपने डिपो में प्राकृतिक गैस का परिवहन एवं संचय करना ।
options.B: गैस का प्रसंस्करण और विभिन्न राज्यों को आवंटन करना ।
options.C: प्राकृतिक गैस का परिवहन, प्रसंस्करण और विपणन करना ।
options.D: अधिक लाभ के लिए भंडारित प्राकृतिक गैस की बिक्री करना ।

options_english.A: To transport and store natural gas at its depot.
options_english.B: To process and allocate natural gas to different states.
options_english.C: To transport, process and market natural gas.
options_english.D: To sale, stored natural gas for greater profit.

questions.solution: GAIL (India) Limited is the central public sector enterprise responsible for the transportation, processing, and marketing of natural gas in India, making option C the correct description.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
अभिकथन (A) : भारत के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार में जल परिवहन एक महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।
कारण (R) : भारत के पश्चिम तट की अपेक्षा पूर्वी तट पर अधिक पत्तन हैं।
विकल्प :
(A) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
(B) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
(C) (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) गलत है।
(D) (A) गलत है, लेकिन (R) सही है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): Water transport plays an important role in the international trade of India.
Reason (R): The east coast of India has more ports than its west coast.
Options:
(A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(B) Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(C) (A) is correct, but (R) is incorrect.
(D) (A) is incorrect, but (R) is correct.

options.A: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true as maritime transport carries a vast majority of India's international trade by volume. Reason (R) is factually incorrect as the western coast has highly developed natural harbors and significant port infrastructure, making option C the correct answer.

questions.text:
'स्वच्छ भारत मिशन' के बारे में निम्नलिखित तथ्यों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
i. यह शहरों के नवीकरण मिशन का हिस्सा है।
ii. इसका शुभारंभ भारत सरकार ने किया ।
iii. यह शहरी क्षेत्र में हरियाली को बढ़ाने से संबंधित है।
iv. इसका उद्देश्य शहरी झुग्गी बस्तियों (slums) में जीवन की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना है।
विकल्प :
(A) केवल i, ii और iii सही हैं।
(B) केवल ii, iii और iv सही हैं।
(C) केवल i, ii और iv सही हैं।
(D) केवल i, iii और iv सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following facts about 'Swachh Bharat Mission' carefully and choose the correct option:
i. It is a part of urban renewable mission.
ii. It is launched by Government of India.
iii. It is associated with improving greenery in urban areas.
iv. It is aimed to improve quality of life in urban slums.
Options:
(A) Only i, ii and iii are correct.
(B) Only ii, iii and iv are correct.
(C) Only i, ii and iv are correct.
(D) Only i, iii and iv are correct.

options.A: केवल i, ii और iii सही हैं।
options.B: केवल ii, iii और iv सही हैं।
options.C: केवल i, ii और iv सही हैं।
options.D: केवल i, iii और iv सही हैं。

options_english.A: Only i, ii and iii are correct.
options_english.B: Only ii, iii and iv are correct.
options_english.C: Only i, ii and iv are correct.
options_english.D: Only i, iii and iv are correct.

questions.solution: The Swachh Bharat Mission is a government initiative focused on cleanliness and hygiene in urban areas, including slum improvement and infrastructure development. Statement iii regarding 'improving greenery' is not a primary objective of this mission, making option C the correct set.
questions.chapter: Geographical Perspective on Selected Issues and Problems

Identify the unit to measure sound from the following:
(A) Particles per hundred
(B) Decibel

questions.solution: The decibel (dB) is the standard unit used to measure the intensity or loudness of sound, including environmental noise pollution.

निम्नलिखित क्षेत्र और उनकी विशेषता से संबंधित सही सुमेलित युग्म का चयन कीजिए ।

Choose the correctly matched pair of areas and their characteristics from the following:

(A) Jhabua District - Bhil Tribe
(B) Daurala Meerut - Gaddi Tribe
(C) Bharmaur Tehsil - Dilapidated Houses

questions.solution: Jhabua district in Madhya Pradesh is well-known for its significant population of Bhil tribal communities. The other pairs do not correctly represent the primary characteristics associated with those regions in the textbook.

questions.text:
कुछ निम्नकोटि भूमियाँ मानवीय प्रक्रियाओं से कृषि के अयोग्य हुई हैं। कथन से सम्बन्धित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
i. स्थानांतरित कृषिजनित क्षेत्र
ii. तटीय मैदान
iii. क्षरित चरागाह
iv. भाबर क्षेत्र
विकल्प :
(A) केवल ii
(B) दोनों ii तथा iv
(C) केवल iii
(D) दोनों i तथा iii
questions.text_english:
Some wastelands are rendered unfit for agriculture by human activities. Choose the correct option related to the statement:
i. Shifting cultivation area
ii. Coastal plains
iii. Degraded pastures
iv. Bhabar areas
Options:
(A) Only ii
(B) Both ii and iv
(C) Only iii
(D) Both i and iii
questions.solution: Human activities like shifting cultivation (jhum) can lead to soil erosion and degradation, as can overgrazing in pastures (i and iii). Coastal plains and Bhabar areas are generally natural features, not primarily rendered unfit by human activity in this context.

questions.text:

By 2050, the world population is estimated to live in urban areas is _______

questions.solution: Global urban planning projections indicate that by the year 2050, roughly two-thirds of the total global population will reside in urban centers.

questions.text:
मानव विकास के मध्यम स्तर वाले देशों में अधिक _______ सुधार चिह्नित होता है।

Case for Free Trade
The act of opening up economies for trading is known as free trade or trade liberalization. This is done by bringing down trade barriers like tariffs. Trade liberalization allows goods and services from everywhere to compete with domestic products and services.
Globalisation along with free trade can adversely affect the economies of developing countries by not giving equal playing field by imposing conditions which are unfavourable. With the development of transport and communication systems goods and services can travel faster and farther than ever before. But free trade should not only let rich countries enter the markets, but allow the developed countries to keep their own markets protected from foreign products.
Countries also need to be cautious about dumped goods; as along with free trade dumped goods of cheaper prices can harm the domestic producers.

questions.solution: Human beings and nature are inherently interdependent. Humans depend on nature for resources, basic survival, and development, while nature itself is shaped by human actions and technological advancements. This intricate relationship defines the human experience and environmental evolution, as societies adapt their lifestyles and technologies to the natural environment, which in turn influences societal progress and cultural development. key_points: Rural: Local needs, periodic markets, agriculture-based.
Urban: Specialized goods, regular markets, diverse services.

questions.solution: Rural marketing centres are typically small, providing basic local goods and services, often functioning as periodic markets like village haats. They cater mainly to agrarian populations for daily needs. In contrast, urban marketing centres offer specialized goods, institutional services, and wholesale trade. They serve larger populations and are centers of higher-order trade and professional services. For example, a local village fair is a rural market, while a central business district or a specialized city market in a major town represents an urban marketing center.

questions.solution: Non-conventional energy sources are essential for India's sustainable development because conventional fossil fuels are finite and cause significant environmental degradation. Utilizing renewable resources like solar energy in desert regions, wind power in coastal areas, and biogas in rural settings reduces our carbon footprint, lowers dependence on imports, and ensures energy security for future generations. These sources are cleaner, sustainable, and help mitigate the adverse effects of climate change, aligning India's energy needs with global environmental standards while fostering eco-friendly local development.

key_points: High birth/death rates to low birth/death rates.

questions.solution:
Immigration refers to the movement of people into a new country or region for permanent settlement, while emigration refers to the departure of people from their home country or region. The demographic transition theory describes the historical shift of societies from high birth and death rates to low birth and death rates as they undergo economic development.

In the first stage, both birth and death rates are high, resulting in slow population growth. In the second stage, death rates drop rapidly while birth rates remain high, leading to a population explosion. In the third stage, birth rates also decline, stabilizing the population. This model explains how societal development, industrialization, and medical advancements influence global demographic patterns over time.

OR

questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 24 से 28 दीर्घ उत्तरीय प्रकार के प्रश्न हैं।
questions.instruction_line_english: Question Nos. 24 to 28 are Long Answer (LA) type questions.

key_points: Role of transport in cost minimization.

questions.solution:
For (a): Transportation costs are a critical determinant in industrial location because they impact the final price of the product. Industries that utilize bulky, heavy, or perishable raw materials prefer to locate near the source to minimize transportation costs (e.g., steel or sugar mills). Industries with high-value, finished goods that are easier to transport may locate near market centers to reduce distribution costs. By optimizing the distance between raw material sources and market outlets, firms maintain competitive pricing and supply chain efficiency.

For (b): Dairy farming is located near urban and industrial centers due to the highly perishable nature of milk and dairy products. Proximity ensures that fresh produce reaches the high-demand urban consumer base quickly, avoiding spoilage and high refrigeration costs during long-distance transportation. Urban markets provide a consistent, high-value consumer demand, and industrial centers offer infrastructure and processing facilities that support large-scale, specialized dairy operations, making it economically rational for these activities to cluster near urban hubs.

questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 24 से 28 दीर्घ उत्तरीय प्रकार के प्रश्न हैं।
questions.instruction_line_english: Question Nos. 24 to 28 are Long Answer (LA) type questions.
questions.solution:
For (a): Target area planning focuses on developing specific, identified backward or disadvantaged regions to bridge developmental gaps. It is necessary because generalized national development programs often fail to reach lagging regions due to unique geographical, cultural, or socio-economic challenges. By concentrating resources and policies on specific target zones, planners can systematically improve infrastructure, employment, and living standards, ensuring equitable growth across the country.

For (b): Regional planning involves the balanced development of a specific geographical area by coordinating various socio-economic policies. The Integrated Tribal Development Project (ITDP) in the Bharmaur region aimed to improve tribal lives through education, healthcare, and infrastructure. Outcomes included improved literacy rates, better access to drinking water and roads, and reduced isolation for the Gadde tribal community, though significant challenges in complete integration and sustainability of services remained. The project successfully facilitated socio-economic upliftment in the region.

questions.solution:
For (a): Indian Railways are the backbone of the country's transport system, playing a pivotal role in economic integration. By efficiently transporting raw materials to industrial centers and finished goods to markets, they significantly lower operational costs for businesses. Furthermore, they provide affordable mobility for millions of passengers daily, supporting labor market mobility and tourism, which directly contributes to GDP growth and national unity.

For (b): Indian ports serve as gateways for international trade, handling over 90% of trade by volume. Continuous development, including the modernization of terminals, deeper draft development for large vessels, and the implementation of automated cargo handling systems, has increased efficiency. These enhancements allow India to handle larger volumes of international freight, reduce turnaround times, and bolster its position in the global supply chain, which is essential for sustained economic success.

questions.text_english:
(a) Evaluate the 'National Youth Policy of India' for overall development of youths and adolescents.
OR
(b) Suggest the measure for overall development of youths and adolescents in India.
questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 24 से 28 दीर्घ उत्तरीय प्रकार के प्रश्न हैं।
questions.instruction_line_english: Question Nos. 24 to 28 are Long Answer (LA) type questions.

key_points: Measures for improvement: Healthcare, empowerment, infrastructure.
Importance of youth as demographic dividend.

questions.solution:
For (a): The National Youth Policy of India aims to leverage the country's 'demographic dividend' by focusing on education, skill development, employment, and health for youth and adolescents. While the policy provides a structured framework for development and empowerment, its evaluation shows progress in expanding education and digital literacy, yet faces significant challenges in translating policies into quality job creation and effective healthcare outreach in remote areas.

For (b): To ensure the holistic development of youth, India should prioritize vocational training, entrepreneurship support, and mental health awareness programs. Enhancing digital connectivity, promoting sports, and increasing the inclusion of marginalized adolescents in educational and leadership programs are essential. By fostering a nurturing environment that encourages innovation, critical thinking, and social participation, India can better harness the potential of its young population to contribute effectively to national development.
